title: Moment of Parting
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji turned around, someone seemed to be watching from afar in the night

text.content: Night like ink, stars like nails. On the barren mountain peak, two silhouettes faced each other. Wind gusted from the depths of the canyon, carrying the coolness of early autumn, scattering Ye Qing's dark hair. She stood with her back to Chen Ji, gazing toward the Holy Sect in the distance, her shoulders tensed like a drawn bow. The content of that transmission, she hadn't said a single word—her informant in the Heavenly Fate Key's secret chamber had vanished. What this meant, both understood clearly.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing suddenly turned around. Moonlight illuminated her cold, serene features, a knowing smile curling at her lips: "Chen Ji, you truly are unfathomable. A废物杂役弟子, yet you survived the machinations of three great sects." She paused, her voice dropping, "...and made this demonic path Holy Sect's saint personally come to this wilderness for a secret meeting with you."

text.content: Upon hearing this, Chen Ji's lips curved slightly upward. On that seemingly honest, simple face emerged a hint of playful amusement. He stood with hands behind his back, posture leisurely as if admiring the moon in his own backyard, showing no signs of being intimidated by her demonic path Holy Sect saint identity. Moonlight fell upon him, reflecting that faded servant's robe as particularly shabby—yet standing there, his bearing resembled a chess player commanding the world.

dialogue.content: "Your Highness the Saint jokes." Chen Ji spoke leisurely, his tone carrying a hint of languor, "I'm merely a废物 with slightly better luck, nothing compared to Your Highness—" He deliberately prolonged the ending, his gaze falling on the demonic patterns faintly visible between Ye Qing's brows, "—who's been used as a chess piece by the Holy Sect for so many years, completely unaware."

text.content: Ye Qing's gaze instantly chilled. Demonic path mists swirled silently, weaving an intangible barrier between them. Yet in the next moment, she laughed—a crisp, silver-bell laugh, yet tinged with bitterness: "You really know quite a lot. Chen Ji, who exactly are you?" Her voice dropped, "...In other words, what kind of existence stands behind you?"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji did not answer. He simply watched Ye Qing quietly, moonlight swirling in the depths of his pupils, as if something was gazing upon this realm. The Tianji Record trembled slightly in his Mental Sea—that three-hour foresight power stirred restlessly—but he forcibly suppressed it. Heavenly Fate Value was precious; it couldn't be wasted on such meaningless probing. His lips curved into a meaningful smile: "Does Her Highness wish to know?"

text.content: Ye Qing did not pursue the question. Though her dealings with Chen Ji weren't particularly long, she had already deeply understood this person's temperament—what he wanted to say, he would say; what shouldn't be asked, even asking would be pointless. She simply stood in silence, gazing at him, letting the night wind flutter both their robes. After a moment, she sighed lightly and broke the silence first: "I should go. The Holy Sect matters cannot be delayed further."

Chen Ji nodded, his expression平静得近乎冷漠. Yet the instant Ye Qing turned to leave, he suddenly spoke: "Ye Qing." This was the first time he addressed her by name, without any honorific or probing tone. Ye Qing's footsteps halted. She looked back, a flash of surprise flickering in her eyes. Chen Ji met her gaze, word by word: "In three months, when the Xuanwu Sect's secret realm opens. Then, I'll give you the answer you want."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing stood stunned. The demonic path mists around her swirled unstably, betraying the turmoil within her. Three months—that was the Xuanwu Sect's once-in-thirty-years secret realm grand ceremony, when the top young powerhouses of the three great sects would gather. And Chen Ji, this废物杂役弟子 of the Tianqing Sect, actually intended to give her an answer in such a setting? She couldn't help but laugh, her smile carrying mockery, doubt, yet also a hint of anticipation she herself hadn't noticed: "You're serious?"

choice.prompt: How should Chen Ji respond to Ye Qing's questioning?

choices.description: Make a promise with a calm demeanor, showcasing meticulous confidence
choices.risk_hint: Excessive confidence may arouse more doubts from Ye Qing

text.content: Chen Ji stood with hands behind his back, robes flapping loudly in the wind. He didn't look at Ye Qing, only gazing up at the starry sky, voice cold yet resolute: "Chen Ji never speaks empty words. In three months, Xuanwu Secret Realm—we shall meet again." As his words fell, he finally tilted his head, offering Ye Qing a meaningful smile, "By then, Your Highness the Saint, do try not to be frightened."

choices.description: Drop the disguise, show your true self, to win Ye Qing's trust
choices.visible_reward: Ye Qing's trust greatly increases, unlocking deep cooperative relationship
choices.risk_hint: Premature exposure may cost the strategic advantage of playing dumb
choices.process_label: 陈机收起笑容，神情认真

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment. When he spoke again, the playfulness in his voice had vanished, replaced by an unusual solemnity: "Ye Qing, I cannot tell you everything. But one thing I can guarantee—everything I do is to break this chess game." He paused, his gaze meeting hers, "And you... are the only person in this chess game I wish to protect."

Ye Qing's expression changed. In those eyes usually shrouded by demonic path mists, genuine波动 first appeared. She parted her lips, seeming to want to say something, but ultimately only sighed softly. "Chen Ji..." she murmured, her voice carrying a softness she herself hadn't noticed, "You really are让人头疼."

dialogue.content: She suddenly stepped forward, close enough to feel each other's breath. Ye Qing raised her hand, fingertips lightly touching Chen Ji's heart—demonic path mists subtly seeping into his robe: "This is the forbidden technique of my Holy Sect. If you encounter any danger in the Xuanwu Secret Realm, I'll sense it immediately." She paused, a cunning smile curling her lips, "Of course, if you dare deceive me—I'll know right away."

text.content: Chen Ji glanced down at the faint black mist over his heart, not alarmed but laughing lightly: "Is Her Highness the Saint worried about me?" He raised his head, meeting Ye Qing's gaze, a hint of warmth flickering in his eyes, "Rest assured, Chen Ji's life is tough. As for you—" His voice suddenly dropped, "Be careful of Ling Yuan on the Holy Sect's end."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing shuddered throughout. Ling Yuan—that old sect master of Tianqing Sect, the puppet secretly supported by the Holy Sect. Her intelligence sharing with Chen Ji never involved such core secrets—how did he know? Yet before she could question further, Chen Ji had already stepped back, restoring the distance. He looked at her, the warmth in his eyes retreating, returning to that unfathomable废物 disciple: "Go. See you in three months."

choice.prompt: What was Chen Ji thinking at the moment of parting?

choices.description: No matter what happens, give her an answer in three months
choices.visible_reward: Unlock the "Pledge" status; Ye Qing's relationship enters a critical phase
choices.risk_hint: Failure to keep the promise will cause trust to collapse drastically
choices.process_label: 陈机在心中默默许下誓言

text.content: Night wind stirred the starry brilliance. Ye Qing's silhouette gradually blurred in Chen Ji's vision, eventually becoming a distant dark speck vanishing into the night depths. Chen Ji stood quietly in place, watching her leave. Only when that dark speck completely vanished did he slowly收回视线, raising his head toward the pale dawn tinting the eastern horizon. Three months. He murmured in his heart. Enough.

choices.description: In chaotic times, romantic feelings only become a burden
choices.visible_reward: Mental state improves; Strategy attribute increases slightly
choices.risk_hint: Excessive suppression may affect subsequent emotional development
choices.process_label: 陈机强行收敛心神，恢复冷漠

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, drawing a deep breath. The demonic path mists Ye Qing left behind pulsed faintly at his heart—that was a trace of weak warmth. He opened his eyes, already ice-cold within. In chaotic times, one farewell could mean eternal separation. He understood this better than anyone. So he couldn't have weaknesses—even if only pretending. The first rays of dawn pierced the clouds, illuminating his pale face.

Morning light scattered, dying the horizon in faint golden-red. Chen Ji drew a breath of crisp air, turning to leave. Yet at that moment, the Tianji Record suddenly vibrated intensely—a danger warning. His footsteps abruptly halted, gaze sweeping the behind-the-scenes dense forest like lightning. There, deathly silence, even insect chirps and bird calls had vanished. Someone was watching him. And—that aura, somewhat familiar.

Chen Ji didn't turn around. He simply stood there, hands behind his back, posture leisurely as if admiring the morning scenery. After a moment, a withered voice emerged from the dense forest, carrying a playful tone: "Chen Ji ah Chen Ji, I thought you were just an obedient servant disciple. Who would've guessed, you've been quite busy behind the scenes." Ling Yuan. Tianqing Sect's old sect master. Chen Ji's lips curved upward as he turned to face those turbid yet profound eyes: "Sect Master Brother, this early?"

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan slowly walked out of the dense forest, morning light spreading behind him, rendering his aged face in alternating light and shadow. He scrutinized Chen Ji up and down, gaze sharp as a blade: "That just now, was the Holy Sect's Saint, right?" He deliberately emphasized the "demonic path" two words, "Our Tianqing Sect may be minor, but we wouldn't associate with demonic path people. Chen Ji, wouldn't you agree?"

text.content: Upon hearing this, Chen Ji showed no panic, instead wearing an honest smile. He scratched his head, looking innocent: "Sect Master Brother misunderstands. That young lady was simply lost, asking me how to get to Tianqing Sect. I kindly pointed the direction, nothing more." He spoke seriously, yet a faint cold glint flickered in his eyes. Ling Yuan ah Ling Yuan, as expected. This debt, I've noted.

choice.prompt: How should Chen Ji deal with Ling Yuan's probing?

choices.description: Continue playing the废物, letting Ling Yuan lower his guard
choices.visible_cost: Subject to further surveillance by Ling Yuan
choices.visible_reward: Maintain the disguise, buying time for scheming
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may already possess partial evidence

text.content: Ling Yuan stared at Chen Ji for a long while before suddenly laughing. That laughter, aged and sinister, echoed in the morning wind: "Kindly pointing directions, indeed. Chen Ji, you think I'm a three-year-old?" He stepped forward, turbid eyes flashing brilliantly, "But never mind, I only came to remind you today—stay obedient, don't meddle in others' affairs. Otherwise..." He didn't finish, but the unsaid implication was sufficiently clear.

choices.description: Imply you have backing, causing Ling Yuan to hesitate
choices.visible_reward: Temporarily intimidate Ling Yuan, gaining breathing space
choices.risk_hint: May arouse greater vigilance from Ling Yuan
choices.process_label: 陈机笑容不变，语气却冷了下来

text.content: The honest smile on Chen Ji's face slowly faded, replaced by a detached calm. He stared directly into Ling Yuan's eyes, voice unhurried: "Sect Master Brother's reminder is noted. However, I'd like to remind Brother—knowing too much isn't always a blessing." With that, he turned and left, presenting Ling Yuan a cold back. Ling Yuan's expression slightly changed, yet didn't pursue. He stared at where Chen Ji departed, a hint of wariness flickering in his eyes.

Chen Ji strode down the mountain path, morning light casting a long shadow behind him. His expression remained平静, as if that exchange was merely a trivial pleasantry. Yet in his heart, tumultuous waves churned. Ling Yuan arrived too coincidentally—Ye Qing left just before, he arrived right after. What did this mean? Within Tianqing Sect, Ling Yuan had informants. Moreover, of high rank.

When Chen Ji returned to the servants' quarters, dawn had already bathed the entire Tianqing Sect. He pushed open that dilapidated wooden door, entering the cramped room that was his. The room's furnishings were extremely meager—a wooden bed, a desk, several yellowed old books. Yet hidden within this simplicity was an extremely concealed hidden compartment. He lifted the bedboard, retrieving an ancient bamboo scroll from the hidden compartment. Tianji Record, first page. Mo Xiansheng's withered silhouette flickered on the scroll: "Back?"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji nodded, spreading the bamboo scroll on the desk. Mo Xiansheng's form slowly manifested from the scroll, aged features carrying a measuring gaze: "Ling Yuan came to find you?" Chen Ji didn't answer, only calmly said: "He came earlier than I anticipated." Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment before sighing: "Boy, your game is getting bigger and bigger. Ling Yuan is just the beginning—when the Heavenly Eye takes notice of you, your little cleverness won't be enough."

text.content: Upon hearing this, Chen Ji's lips curved into a faint smile. He tucked the bamboo scroll into his robes, walking to the window, gazing at the rising sun outside. Morning light fell upon his face, rendering his expression in clear light and shadow. On that seemingly ordinary face, a chilling steadiness and composure now appeared. "Enough or not," he murmured, as if answering Mo Xiansheng, or speaking to himself, "let's see." Outside, Tianqing Sect's bells rang悠悠, a new day had begun.

And at this moment, deep within the Holy Sect thousands of miles away, a pair of eyes peered through layers of mists, gazing upon all this. That was neither Ling Yuan nor anyone Chen Ji knew. That was a transcendent will, ice-cold and merciless, eternal and everlasting. It had watched countless prophets' births and falls through endless ages, and today, the Tianji Record's bearer seemed finally set to walk an extraordinary path. The Heavenly Eye slightly narrowed, carrying a playful glint: "Interesting."
